warnings.headline: Moderate Wind Warning (Degree 2/4) - Slovenia / South-West
warnings.description: Maximum wind speed : from 70 to 85 km/h. Wind sways trees and may break branches. It impedes road traffic of certain categories and may hinder movement to some extent. The sea is fairly rough (3).
warnings.instruction:
Before the event:
Close all windows and doors. Stow or fasten anything that could be carried away by the wind. Check the situation of vessels in berths.

During the event:

warnings.sender: Slovenian Environment Agency (ARSO vreme)

warnings.headline: Moderate Rain Warning (Degree 2/4) - Slovenia / South-West
warnings.description: Rainfall : from 25 to 50 mm/24h. Watercourses may overflow in areas usually prone to annual floods. Debris may clog certain river culverts.
warnings.instruction: The population in the affected areas should follow the trend of water level and hydrological updates.
warnings.sender: Slovenian Environment Agency (ARSO vreme)

warnings.headline: Moderate Wind Warning (Degree 2/4) - Slovenia / North-East
warnings.description: Maximum wind speed : from 50 to 70 km/h. Wind sways trees and may break smaller branches.
warnings.instruction: Doors and windows should be kept closed. We recommend additional caution in traffic, especially in crosswinds and in exposed areas (e.g. bridges, cuttings). Do not linger in potentially dangerous areas.
warnings.sender: Slovenian Environment Agency (ARSO vreme)
